what: Build the node/embedding/leaf schema separation: the paper's three-layer schema (§3.1, §6.4) replacing the flat one-table-per-tenant shape. One shared node set (cairn_nodes) owned by the librarian, an embeddings table (cairn_embeddings) for many-per-node vector renderings, per-tree leaf tables referencing the shared set. Migrate 1,314 existing rows across 10 tables. Wire the inference-to-node pipeline so resolved calls deposit as knowledge nodes.
why: The papers cannot be released until the schema they describe is built. Akien: 'it looks from here like you built an inference cache, rather than have the inference cache be part of the librarian's KB.'
